notes.subject: בעליך עשיך
notes.rationale: Deg taɛbranit: amḍan n deffir ('baɛlen-ik, wid i-k-ixelqen'); tuccḍa tameqqrant — amḍan ushid neɣ asuf? Susuqilten qquren tt-qqlen-t s usuf.

notes.subject: Umeḥbus-ik
notes.rationale: גואל d 'umeḥbus' deg ṭṭerf n teqlilt — d win yettḥaznen s ṣedeq n leɛṣel, mačči kan 'ameḥbus'.

notes.subject: ⟨d⟩
notes.rationale: Taqbaylit tesra taseddast 'd' deg sin n yimukan, taɛbranit ur tesɛi ara.

notes.subject: taserdunt n Ṣiyyon
notes.rationale: Awal-a yettmessaɣal ɣer tmettut/tamdint n Yerucalayim s tuqqna n takeddast.

translation: Axaṭer baɛl-ik d Win i-k-ixelqen — Yahwe Ṣebaot yisem-is; ⟨d⟩ Umeḥbus-ik, ⟨d⟩ Iqedcen n Yisrael, Elohim n tmurt akk ad yettwabdaren.
